text: I love it, although I don't get the chance very often. For me, the best part isn't the sightseeing but the small everyday things, like trying local food in a market or working out how the public transport works in a new city.

tips.en: The speaker picks something less obvious, which makes it personal.
tips.kk: Автор айқын емес нәрсені ерекшелейді — бұл жауапты жеке етеді.
tips.ru: Автор выделяет не очевидное — это делает ответ личным.
tips.example: the best part isn't the sightseeing

tips.en: Two concrete examples support the idea.
tips.example: like trying local food in a market

note.en: “I do not often have the opportunity”.

questions.followUp: Where did you go most recently?
questions.question: Do you like travelling?

text: Usually with a friend or two. It's more fun to share experiences, and it's also safer and cheaper, because you can split the cost of accommodation. Having said that, I'd like to try travelling alone at least once, just to see how independent I can be.

tips.en: More fun, safer, cheaper — a convincing case.
A concession and a wish to try the other option — not one-sided.
tips.kk: Мойындау және басқасын байқап көру ниеті — жауап біржақты емес.
tips.ru: Уступка и желание попробовать другое — ответ не категоричен.

questions.question: Do you prefer travelling alone or with others?

text: Probably Turkistan, in the south of Kazakhstan. I went there with my family a couple of years ago to see the mausoleum of Khoja Ahmed Yasawi. The building itself is stunning, but what impressed me most was how much history there is in such a small town.

tips.en: Where, when, who with and why — full but short.
tips.kk: Қайда, қашан, кіммен және не үшін — толық әрі қысқа жауап.
tips.ru: Где, когда, с кем и зачем — полный, но короткий ответ.
tips.example: I went there with my family a couple of years ago

tips.en: Highlights the main impression — a strong ending.
tips.example: what impressed me most was how much history there is

questions.question: What is the most interesting place you have visited?

text: I usually book transport and accommodation well in advance, because it's much cheaper that way. But once I'm there, I prefer not to plan every hour. I like leaving some free time to wander around, since the best moments on a trip are often the ones you didn't expect.

tips.en: Before and during the trip — a clear structure.
tips.kk: Сапарға дейін және сапар кезінде — жауаптың анық құрылымы.
tips.ru: До поездки и во время — ясная структура ответа.
tips.example: But once I'm there, I prefer not to plan every hour

tips.en: The last sentence explains the choice with a thoughtful observation.
tips.kk: Соңғы сөйлем таңдауды парасатты байқаумен түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Последняя фраза объясняет выбор мудрым наблюдением.

title.en: A general point at the end

tips.example: the best moments on a trip are often the ones you didn't expect

questions.followUp: Do you like having a fixed plan?
questions.question: How do you usually plan a trip?

text: I'd love to go to Japan one day. I've always been fascinated by the way it combines very modern cities with old traditions, and I'd really like to see the cherry blossom in spring. The only problem is that it's quite expensive, so I'll need to save up for a while.

tips.en: Present perfect explains a long-standing interest.
tips.kk: Present perfect ұзақ уақытқы қызығушылықты түсіндіреді.

tips.en: Mentioning an obstacle makes the answer natural.

note.en: A phrasal verb: collect money for something.

questions.question: Is there anywhere you would really like to visit in the future?
